messages:
maria_research: Nightly eval alarm for KBQA promptset just fired — coverage dropped ~8 points vs yesterday. eval-bot link: https://evals.internal/runs/2410001111 :alert:
ci-bot: Automated diff: 8.2% drop in 'answer_coverage', 5.7% increase in 'hallucination_score'. See artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/kbqa/2410001111/*
dan_engineer: grabbing a few failing examples now. Quick snippet shows repeated 'None' anchors and truncated JSONL outputs.
lydia_ml: can you paste one? curious if this is tokenization or KV cache related.
dan_engineer: pasted one below:
```
input: "What is the capital of Freedonia?"
model_output: "{\"answer\": \"\", \"source\": \"wiki\"}"
notes: repeated empty answer, sometimes returns unrelated entity (Miramax)
```
sara_prod: UX reports a small but noticeable uptick in 500s from hosted kbqa route since ~02:10 UTC — could be correlated.
lydia_ml: timeline: nightly run used the new int8-packedkv candidate (ptq-v2) that was staged yesterday at canary. Did the canary finish?
dan_engineer: yes, rollout pipeline marked canary complete at 01:50 but gating checks were only perf/cost — no semantic eval gating enabled.
maria_research: root hypothesis: PTQ-packedkv changed kv-layout, causing prefix alignment issues -> empty answers and hallucinations under certain prompts.
onchalant: :thinking_face: (reaction)
dan_engineer: repro steps: locally ran model with same quant config and ran the failing promptset with seed fixed. Observed empty answers on ~12% of inputs. Attached logs show KV offsets jumping at step ~43.
```
[2026-03-20T01:42:13Z] kv_offset: 0x1a4f -> 0x1b2c (expected +0x20)
[2026-03-20T01:42:13Z] kv_stride_mismatch: true
```
lydia_ml: that aligns with packed-kv stride bug we saw in PTQ stage earlier this quarter (but thought fixed). Could be new pack algorithm edge-case for short prompts.
sara_prod: recommended mitigation? customers already had small increase in errors.
dan_engineer: immediate actions I'd take: 1) Pause canary traffic for ptq-v2 2) Pin hosted KBQA route to previous quantized build (ptq-v1) 3) Kick off targeted canary with semantic gating (nightly QA + promptset) 4) Add an automatic rollback rule if coverage drops >3% in canary.
oncall: I can take step 1 and 2 now. Oncall will patch routing.
oncall: done — ptq-v2 canary paused, KBQA pinned to ptq-v1 at 02:38 UTC.
ci-bot: Started semantic canary job: kbqa-promptset-run-2410001350. Will report back when complete.
maria_research: For root cause, allocate an ML engineer + runtime pair to reproduce in dev with instrumentation: --dump-kv-positions, --kv-verify. Also add a small eval harness that runs across short prompt distribution.
dan_engineer: I'll create a minimal repro and open a PR with a test that asserts kv_stride == expected for short contexts.
lydia_ml: longer-term: add semantic gating to model bring-up checklist. Quant bring-up should require nightly promptset pass (coverage and hallucination thresholds) before canary unpause.
sara_prod: agree. Also add cost/perf exemptions so gating doesn't block perf-only experiments but prevents semantic regressions to production.
maria_research: Action items recap:
- dan_engineer: repro + PR with kv-verification test (due 2410002000)
- lydia_ml: add gating rule to onboarding checklist + update runbook (due 2410002300)
- ci-bot: run extended semantic canary and post artifacts (in progress)
- oncall: pinned route and paused canary (done)
- sara_prod: monitor customer error rates and notify if >2% increase (ongoing)

Anyone object to keeping ptq-v2 out of auto-rollout until the repro/test is green?
lydia_ml: no objections.
dan_engineer: will also add a short-term post-deploy probe that runs 200 prompt samples and fails fast if coverage < baseline -3%.
maria_research: thanks. After ci-bot posts canary results we can close the thread and track PR + checklist changes in the onboarding epic.
ci-bot: Canary finished: coverage delta -1.1% (within threshold) but hallucination_score up 2.9% — attaching examples: s3://redwood-evals/kbqa/2410001350/failed_examples.jsonl
sara_prod: thanks — I'm re-opened a support watch and will escalate if customer impact grows.
maria_research: closing for now. We'll reopen if PR doesn't land or canary fails further checks. :white_check_mark:
